frames.title: Curtain bangs falling flat?
frames.sub: It's the drying, not the cut ↓

frames.title: Dampen the roots
frames.sub: Bangs take their shape as they dry.

frames.title: Dry both ways
frames.sub: Lift at the root, cool air last.

frames.title: Roll them back
frames.sub: Away from your face, then unroll.

pins.title: Korean Curtain Bangs Tutorial: Easy Styling Steps

items.title: Dampen the roots
items.body: A little water so the bangs reset.

items.title: Dry side to side
items.body: Left, then right, to lift the root.

items.title: Part in the middle
items.body: A soft centre part with your fingers.

items.title: Roll them back
items.body: A big velcro roller, about 10 minutes.

items.title: Cool air to set
items.body: A light mist of hairspray if needed.
